## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » Streaming Top Categories


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000100365


## Settings Documentation for Streaming Top Categories


This document provides detailed descriptions of the settings available for configuring the streaming top categories section on the platform. Each setting allows for customization to meet specific needs and preferences.

To edit these settings, navigate to:

- In the Admin Sidebar Open Settings

- Select Designs Settings

- Open The Homepage Tab

- Open The Module Select Content to Display

- Select The Streaming Top Categories Option


## Visual Guide of the  Streaming Top Categories


These are the available settings for the Streaming Top Categories section:


## 1. Top Categories Title


This setting allows the administrator to set the title for the top categories section. The title can be customized by entering the desired text in the provided input field.


## 2. Title Color


The title color setting enables the customization of the title's color. Administrators can choose a color by inputting the desired color code or using the color picker tool provided.


## 3. Display Options


This setting controls the number of top categories displayed. Administrators can select from a range of options, from 1 to 100 results. Additionally, the layout can be adjusted to show a specific number of results per row, ranging from 2 to 4 results per row.


## 4. Enable Carousel Slider


The carousel slider option allows top categories to be displayed in a sliding carousel format. This can be toggled on or off using the provided dropdown menu.


## 5. Hide On Mobile


This setting allows administrators to choose whether the top categories section should be hidden on mobile devices. It can be enabled or disabled using the dropdown menu.


## 6. Show "View All" Button


The "View All" button allows users to see all top categories. This setting can be toggled on or off using the dropdown menu.


## 7. Sorting Categories


This setting allows administrators to choose the sorting order of the categories. Options include sorting by name (A-Z or Z-A) or by order (ascending or descending), or ID (ascending or descending).


## 8. Only Show Categories with Photos


Administrators can choose to display only those categories that have photos. This setting ensures that categories without photos are excluded from the top categories list.
